Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: orthographic albedo texture-source painting for an existing 3D game decoration, the Giant rib bone. Deliver exactly one 1024 x 1024 PNG with a genuinely transparent background.

INPUT ROLES, in attachment order:
1. guide_left.png is the EDIT TARGET and immutable geometry/alpha/layout authority: the exact 3D model seen from its left side.
2. design_reference.png is the approved design, colour and surface-material authority only; do not copy its three-quarter camera, framing, lighting or background.
3. concept_crop.png is the original concept, supplementary material reference.

Paint the existing grey surfaces of image 1 in place. Keep its silhouette EXACTLY: identical outline, size, position, every shape edge, opening and detail. Preserve its alpha footprint and large empty transparent margins. The object occupies only x=275..748 and y=409..614 within the 1024-square canvas, with topmost vertex near (512,409), outermost ground-root edges near (275,597) and (748,597), and lowest center near (512,614). Do not enlarge, move, rotate, reframe, crop, smooth, reshape or add geometry. This is the end-on left orthographic view from the guide, not the long three-quarter side view in the design. Keep every existing root branch and gap exactly where the guide places it.

MATERIALS: apply the reference's warm ivory bone with irregular brown-amber cracks and stains to the bone mass. Apply thin black-violet resin-root material to the existing root shapes, using the reference's deep purple colour. Surface crack patterns are painted colour, not extra edges or sculpted relief. Preserve every existing detail and opening; add no roots, debris or silhouettes. Any orange glowing seams are painted at their orange local colour only, with no light cast onto nearby surfaces.

LIGHTING: strictly ALBEDO/base colour. Even flat shadowless illumination from the viewer. No cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no directional or form-shading gradients, no strong specular highlights, no reflections, no rim light. Retain material colour differences and stains, not the grey guide's lighting or the reference's cinematic lighting. No background, no floor, no ground shadow, no vignette, no halo, no text.

OUTPUT: a single unresized 1024 x 1024 RGBA return. Keep the exact guide footprint, camera, framing and transparent exterior unchanged; change only the surface colours/material painting.
